verdict.rationale: Conductor orchestrates general-purpose coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in isolated workspaces. The docs say those agents can test repositories, edit setup scripts and run builds, and failing-check logs and PR comments are surfaced to workspaces, which supports CI-driven fix loops. However, none of the four specific tasks is explicitly documented as a workflow, and 'test your repositories' refers to running tests rather than writing them. missing for 10: explicit test-writing support, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, dependency updating, and any hands-on corroboration of these tasks.
